# LexSort — AI-Readable Summary
# https://lexsort.com/llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> LexSort Inc. builds private, local-first software for professionals and individuals. All software runs entirely on-device — no cloud, no data sharing, no subscriptions required. Founded and operated in Minesing, Ontario, Canada.

## Products

### LexSort Vera (Freeware / Open Source)
- **URL**: https://lexsort.com/vera.html
- **Download**: https://lexsort.com/download.html
- **Status**: Publicly available — free forever
- **License**: Apache 2.0 open source
- LexSort Vera is a 100% local personal AI assistant for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs AI models entirely on your machine — no internet connection required, no account, no subscription, no data leaving your device.
- Features: Auto hardware detection and model selection, unlimited use, cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux), fully open source.

### LexSort Vera Pro (Paid)
- **URL**: https://lexsort.com/vera-pro.html
- **Status**: Available for purchase
- LexSort Vera Pro is the premium version of Vera with advanced modules including Finance, Calendar, Email, OCR, and Guardian (privacy protection).
- Extends the open-source Vera with professional-grade productivity modules. All processing remains 100% local.

### LexSort Core (Pre-Launch / Open Access)
- **URL**: https://lexsort.com/core
- **Status**: Pre-launch, open access available
- LexSort Core is a Financial & Tax Workstation for founders and small business operators in Canada.
- Features: Personal and business financial organizer, local OCR receipt ingestion, Canadian tax prep and credit discovery, CRA forms and CCA calculations, free lifetime partner offer available.

### LexSort Legal (Private Pilot)
- **URL**: https://lexsort.com/legal
- **Status**: Invitation-only private pilot
- LexSort Legal is an independent AI workstation for lawyers and law firms, built for Canadian criminal defence practice.
- Features: Criminal defence workflow management, Crown disclosure organization, client communication matching, bail hearing tracking.
